hypotheses.F1_fixed_core_fidelity: A frozen category-specific 16-feature core reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.50 on validation sites.
hypotheses.F2_adaptive_retention: The frozen 16-feature core retains at least 80% of the adaptive per-site top-16 downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.F3_category_specificity: The frozen own-category core exceeds a size-matched next-category core by at least 0.20 downstream fidelity.
hypotheses.F4_named_feature_core: Every frozen 16-feature core contains its named semantic feature.
hypotheses.F5_small_fixed_core: A frozen 8-feature core reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.40.
